system.description:
Starting, at 2nd Level, your technique and skill with Medical Ninjutsu has allowed you to manifest a state of ascendant skill, allowing you to be the hero everyone needs when called upon.

As a bonus action, while you are in combat, you can enter as state of Ascension for the next minute. Once you enter this state, you cannot enter it again until you complete 10 minutes of uninterrupted meditation and recovery.

Ascension

Will Amp

Once per turn, when you restore hit points or grants temporary hit points to a creature with a Jutsu you cast, you gain 1 Healing Surge (Max 3). You can spend these Healing Surges in the following ways. Abilities that reference hit die mean the affected creatures hit die, and does not spend them.

Battle Surge. As an Action, by spending 1 surge, you release a surge of energy that reinforces the combat potential of your allies. All allied creatures of your choice, excluding yourself, within a 15-foot radius, centered on you gains 1 Battle Surge (Max 1) which last for 1 minute or until used. This battle surge can be used in place of any 1 Class or Subclass based special resource (Genjutsu specialists, Actualization, Hunters Exploits, Medical Nin Domain Charges, etc.). A creature can benefit from Battle Surge once every other turn.

Healing Burst. As a bonus action, by spending 1 surge, you can release a burst of rejuvenating energize around you. All willing allied creatures of your choice within a 20-foot radius centering on you regains Hit points equal to 1 Hit Die + their Constitution Modifier. This becomes 2 Hit Die at 10th level. This does not work on creatures at 0 Hit points.

Vitality Guard. When an allied creature within 30 feet of you takes damage, you can spend your Reaction and 1 Surge to grant the allied creature resistance to the triggering damage.
